pairs: and I will sing psalms in my glory.
I will arise in early morning.
I will confess to you, O Lord, among the peoples.
Domine, et psallam tibi in nationibus:
And I will sing psalms to you among the nations.
quia magna est super cælos misericordia tua,
For your mercy is great, beyond the heavens,
et usque ad nubes veritas tua.
and your truth, even to the clouds.
Exaltare super cælos, Deus, et super omnem terram gloria tua:
Be exalted, O God, beyond the heavens, and your glory, beyond all the earth,
so that your beloved may be freed.
Deus locutus est in sancto suo:
God has spoken in his holiness.
and I will divide by measure the steep valley of tabernacles.
and Ephraim is the supporter of my head.
Moab is the cooking pot of my hope.
I will extend my shoe in Idumea;
the foreigners have become my friends.
Quis deducet me in civitatem munitam?
Who will lead me into the fortified city?
quis deducet me usque in Idumæam?
Who will lead me, even into Idumea?
for vain is the help of man.
In God, we will act virtuously,
et ipse ad nihilum deducet inimicos nostros.
and he will bring our enemies to nothing.
